attrs.label: Uploading files
attrs.class: grid w-full max-w-sm grid-cols-2 gap-y-2 text-sm

examples.label: Upload with a percentage readout
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-headless-progress" site="Global" id="upload-progress" value={40} label="Uploading files" show_value class="grid w-full max-w-sm grid-cols-2 gap-y-2 text-sm" label_class="font-medium" value_class="text-right tabular-nums opacity-70" track_class="col-span-2 h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-current/15" indicator_class="rounded-full bg-current transition-[width] duration-500" />

examples.label: Loading bar with no known end
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-headless-progress" site="Global" id="loading-progress" label="Loading" class="grid w-full max-w-sm gap-y-2 text-sm" label_class="font-medium" track_class="h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-current/15" indicator_class="h-full w-1/3 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-current" />
